name: Grey Clement
life: “I still remember opening a storage room that used to have curtains.” People around the public end of the South Shore boardwalk know Grey by a small Wednesday habit. Grey checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I found an old lease with a shore room included. The room is now the marina's expensive equipment store.
appearance: Grey has two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Look for a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Back on the street, the familiar outfit is a soft blue checked shirt with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Grey rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Grey treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To verify the lease provision for shore housing.
family: Ruben Choi is Grey’s half-sibling. Grey is free to hang up first. Ruben makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The porch auction*, Ruben says, “I wanted the wood for toys. The owner asked me to make one chair small enough for her new kitchen.”
connections: Rowan Kelly. The old berth lease may give the displaced resident a real key ashore.

reactions.situation: A yard manager asks the liveaboard to leave by Friday
reactions.response: Grey asks where the resident can sleep on the first night ashore.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Grey stays where the child can see the shop door and asks the neighboring counter to help find the adult expected there.
